text:
riya: Quick heads-up 1 opened a tiny docs PR to reconcile the 429 troubleshooting notes with the SDK examples. Main changes: replace two stale links, add a minimal curl that shows Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Remaining, and a 2-line JS backoff snippet. Can someone glance?

tom: On it. Please make the curl explicitly non-prod and include the exact header names we expect SDKs to read: `Retry-After`, `retry-after-ms`, and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`.

riya: Done. Curl under staging host + synthetic key:
```
curl -i -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference.net/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SYNTHETIC_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"test-mini","prompt":"x","max_tokens":1}'
```
Notes say: look for `Retry-After` (seconds) or `retry-after-ms` (ms), and X-RateLimit-Remaining for quota awareness.

elena: Could you add a one-line note about handling float values in `Retry-After` and converting millis->secs? Also include a suggestion to prefer server `Retry-After` when present, fallback to `X-RateLimit-Reset` if set.

riya: Added a short sentence about float parsing and an example of using `Math.ceil(retryAfterMs/1000)` when converting.

sam: Please add a tiny context-trim example using our internal `conversation-slice` tool (1-line) so customers migrating from long-history flows have a clear path. Keep it non-sensitive.

riya: Added: `conversation-slice --input convo.json --max-tokens 2048 --policy=drop-oldest` and a note: run this only on copies of data in staging, scrub PII.

ci-bot: Linkcheck started on branch docs/2133-429-snip-fix. Found 2 broken paths: /guides/old-rate -> 404, /sdk/js/retries-v0 -> 410.

tom: For /guides/old-rate create redirect -> /runbooks/rate-limits. For the SDK link update to /sdk/js/retries, please.

riya: Pushed redirect rules and updated the JS SDK anchor. Also tightened wording on the fallback behavior: if after N retries still 429, recommend routing to a lower-cost/shorter-context model and return a `degraded` flag in response.

elena: Editorial nit: change "degraded" flag wording to "fallback": users found "degraded" ambiguous.

riya: Swapped to `fallback` flag. Also added a tiny pseudo-response example: { "output": "...", "fallback": true }. Kept it compact to avoid MD lint.

ops-bot: Staging docs deploy scheduled for 2026-04-10 06:00 UTC. Preview generated; snippet rendering OK.

riya: Thanks! Will merge after staging smoke passes. Closing thread :sparkles:
